store.summary: TH-D75 Bluetooth controls, APRS inbox, weather and KISS bridges.
store.description: Part of the Nomad tools by Tech Nomad Ted, TheTechNomad.com. Kenwood TH-D75 companion over Bluetooth: frequency, mode, power, squelch and volume controls with readback, native and KISS APRS receive, readable position/telemetry/weather reports, an APRS inbox with replies, a station map (OpenStreetMap tiles, cached for offline use) and optional BLE/TCP KISS bridges for phone or PC apps. Arrows move, Right opens, Left backs out; keys 4-8 switch pages, and in a packet Back, Map, Save, Reply, Raw.
